# VIPACH Exhibition Archive

> Official directory of past VIPACH photography exhibitions in Vienna, Austria. Exhibitions are offered in Hungarian, English and Austrian German.

- [Exhibition facts (JSON)](https://exhibition.vipach.at/data/public/exhibitions.json): source-linked exhibition dates, venue, catalogue counts and display status.
- [VIPACH](https://www.vipach.at/): Vienna Photo Art & Creative Hub, an initiative within the Vienna Hungarian School and its supporting federation.

## Published exhibitions
- [SPONTANEOUS](https://exhibition.vipach.at/spontan-2026/): 2026-11-15 through 2026-11-21 at CITYgalleryVIENNA (Mahlerstraße 11, 1010 Vienna, Austria); 20 works and 16 identified artists. [Hungarian](https://exhibition.vipach.at/hu/spontan-2026/) · [German](https://exhibition.vipach.at/de/spontan-2026/). [Venue record](https://publicartists.online/event/vipach-151126/).
- [The Image of My Life](https://exhibition.vipach.at/eletem-kepe/): 2025-12-07 through 2025-12-13 at CITYgalleryVIENNA (Mahlerstraße 11, 1010 Vienna, Austria); 20 works and 15 identified artists. [Hungarian](https://exhibition.vipach.at/hu/eletem-kepe/) · [German](https://exhibition.vipach.at/de/eletem-kepe/). [Venue record](https://publicartists.online/event/eletem-kepe-071225/).
- [As I Like It Austria](https://exhibition.vipach.at/as-i-like-it-austria/): 2025-11-30 through 2025-12-06 at CITYgalleryVIENNA (Mahlerstraße 11, 1010 Vienna, Austria); 20 works and 19 identified artists. [Hungarian](https://exhibition.vipach.at/hu/as-i-like-it-austria/) · [German](https://exhibition.vipach.at/de/as-i-like-it-austria/). [Venue record](https://publicartists.online/event/bmi-fotoclub-301125/).

## SPONTÁN date and source note
- [CITYgalleryVIENNA venue listing](https://publicartists.online/event/vipach-151126/) confirms public visits from 15 through 21 November 2026, closing at 20:00 Vienna time on the 21st. The 15 November reception began at 16:00 and the official opening at 17:00.
- The older [VIPACH Wix event listing](https://www.vipach.at/event-details/spontan-vipach-fotokiallitas-2026) carried a 22 November calendar end. This is a historical listing discrepancy, not the confirmed public visiting period.
